solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: 28 warns of total despair at what you have in store today!

definitions.text: 28 warns of total despair at what you have in store today!

parts.words: 28 warns of total despair at what you have in store today!
parts.note: 28 is the poet of the Inferno, whose gate of Hell bears this famous inscription telling arriving souls that every expectation must be given up; the clue jokingly hangs it over a shop or a working day

explanation.surface: A gloomy writer predicts a miserable day ahead, or perhaps a dismal shop.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross-reference 28 is DANTE; in the Inferno this line is written over the gateway to Hell. 'In store' puns on what awaits and on a shop doorway.
explanation.definitionFit: The quoted line is the famous warning in the Divine Comedy that souls entering Hell must give up all expectation of rescue.

clue.text: Have sex with companion and colleague

parts.note: to bed someone is to have sex with them
a fellow is a companion or comrade

explanation.surface: An office romance: sleeping with a workmate.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedfellow is an associate or ally, someone working alongside you, as in strange bedfellows.

clue.text: Nice refusal to accommodate odd Yale fabric is artificial

indicators.note: the refusal takes the other letters in, so accommodate signals enclosure

parts.note: non is French for no, as spoken in Nice on the Riviera

indicators.note: odd picks the first and third letters of Yale

explanation.surface: A French refusal to admit an American university's fabric is fake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nice' is the French city, not the adjective, so the refusal is French NON; 'odd' takes Y and L from Yale, placed inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Nylon is a synthetic polymer textile, the first wholly man-made fibre in wide use.

clue.text: Her co-star jostled with a number of players

indicators.note: jostled means pushed about, so the letters are shoved into a new order

explanation.surface: An actress's co-star was elbowed among a group of performers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jostled' rearranges HER CO-STAR.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchestra is a large group of instrumental musicians playing together.

clue.text: Going in watching everyone in the joint

indicators.note: going in means entering, so the answer lies inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Entering a club while everyone in the place looks on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the joint' looks like slang for a venue but is a door's pivot.
explanation.definitionFit: A hinge is the jointed fitting on which a door or lid swings.

clue.text: One who's for, not against, telling tales

definitions.note: a single person, here an academic teacher

indicators.note: one word stands where the other used to be, so not signals a substitution

parts.note: a confessor tells all, admitting secrets
con means against, as in pros and cons
pro means for or in favour of

explanation.surface: Someone takes the side of gossips rather than opposing them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for, not against' swaps PRO in for CON, turning CONFESSOR into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A university academic is a person, so the bare word One serves as a minimal definition of that teacher.

clue.text: Put up with housing proposal in uneven area

indicators.note: housing means holding within, so the proposal goes inside
uneven picks the odd-numbered letters of area

parts.note: a bid is an offer or proposal

explanation.surface: Tolerating a housing scheme in a rough neighbourhood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uneven' takes the first and third letters of 'area', A and E, which house BID.
explanation.definitionFit: To abide something is to tolerate or endure it, as in I can't abide noise.

clue.text: Gale is blowing, so support beneficiary

indicators.note: a gale blowing scatters things, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a tee supports a golf ball before it is struck

explanation.surface: In a storm, a golfer still needs a peg for the ball.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blowing' signals the anagram; 'support' is a golf peg, not a prop for the wind-battered.
explanation.definitionFit: A legatee is someone who receives a legacy under a will, a type of beneficiary.

clue.text: Soon start to make fun of son's shifts

indicators.note: start to means the opening letter of soon

parts.note: to mock is to ridicule
S is the abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: Kids will tease the boy's clothing before long.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shifts' means loose garments, not changes or work periods.
explanation.definitionFit: A smock and a shift are both loose, simple garments hanging from the shoulders.

clue.text: Song in musical drained of style

indicators.note: the song sits within the remaining letters of the musical, so in signals one piece placed inside another
a drained word is emptied of its contents, leaving only its outer letters

parts.note: an ode is a lyric poem or song

explanation.surface: A tune in a stage show has lost all its flair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drained' empties 'musical' to its outer letters M and L, and ODE goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A model is a particular design or type of product, as in this year's style of car.

clue.text: Cheering those who are anti- polluting (I'm not included)

parts.note: cons are those against, as in pros and cons

indicators.note: the I is left out of the polluting word, so not included signals a removal

parts.note: oiling, fouling with oil, is a kind of polluting
I'm is I am, contributing just the letter I

explanation.surface: An encouraging note about environmental protesters, with the speaker standing apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anti- polluting' reads as one compound but splits into two pieces; 'not included' drops the I, leaving OLING.
explanation.definitionFit: Consoling words comfort and hearten someone, a synonym of cheering in the sense of raising spirits.

clue.text: Sterilise with chlorine solution, protected by European statute ultimately

parts.note: Cl is the chemical symbol for chlorine

indicators.note: the solution sits sheltered between the two E letters, so protected by signals enclosure
ultimately points to the final letter of statute

parts.note: ANS is a common abbreviation for answer, which is a solution

explanation.surface: A disinfecting chlorine mix, required by EU law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'protected by' puts ANS between E (European) and E, the last letter of 'statute' picked by 'ultimately'.
explanation.definitionFit: To cleanse is to make thoroughly clean, which overlaps with sterilising something to kill germs.

clue.text: A small amount found in electric kettle

definitions.meaning: a trace or touch, as in an ... of truth
the heating coil in a kettle that warms the water

explanation.surface: A tiny residue discovered inside a kettle, perhaps limescale.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a small trace of something and the electrical heating part inside appliances such as kettles.

clue.text: These days, she's first to make cold dish

indicators.note: the girl's name is placed ahead of the other piece despite coming later in the clue

parts.note: Sal is a girl's name, a she
AD, anno domini, denotes the present era

explanation.surface: Nowadays she always serves something chilled first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' moves SAL ahead of AD, the abbreviation for the current era.
explanation.definitionFit: A salad is a dish of raw or cold vegetables and other ingredients, usually served chilled.

clue.text: Criminal is anxious to replace note for work

indicators.note: one piece takes the place of another, so replace signals a substitution

parts.note: desperate means extremely anxious
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale
to do something is to work at it

explanation.surface: An offender is keen to swap music for a job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to replace ... for' swaps the TE ending of DESPERATE for DO.
explanation.definitionFit: A desperado is a reckless outlaw, especially one from the American Wild West.

clue.text: He merits a fresh holiday home

indicators.note: fresh suggests something newly made over, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man deserves a new place to stay on vacation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fresh' signals rearranging HE MERITS A.
explanation.definitionFit: A timeshare is a jointly owned property where each owner gets a set period of vacation use each year.

clue.text: Parisian shop girl, small thing, to eat in with model

indicators.note: the eating and the model go inside the small thing, so in signals enclosure

parts.note: a mite is a tiny creature or object

indicators.note: with joins the model on after the eating

parts.note: to dine is to eat
the Model T was Ford's famous car, so model gives T

explanation.surface: A young Paris shop assistant dining out with a fashion model.
explanation.walkthrough: 'model' suggests a fashion model but gives T, from Ford's Model T car.
explanation.definitionFit: A midinette is a French word for a young shop worker or seamstress, especially in Paris.

clue.text: Romania is discovered not so far from here!

definitions.note: describes a region near the country named in the clue

indicators.note: discovered, read as uncovered, suggests the letters are laid open and rearranged

explanation.surface: An explorer finds Romania is close by.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discovered' rearranges ROMANIA IS; the old name for Anatolia lies just across the Black Sea from Romania.
explanation.definitionFit: The historic name for the Anatolian peninsula of modern Turkey, a short distance across the Black Sea from Romania.

clue.text: Directions to place where organs are sold?

parts.note: N, E, W and S are the four compass directions
to stand something is to place it

explanation.surface: A sinister request for the address of a body-parts market.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organs' means newspapers and periodicals, not body parts, so the question mark flags the pun.
explanation.definitionFit: A kiosk selling papers is where organs, in the sense of journals or periodicals, are bought.

clue.text: Posy recalled times with nothing in US city

indicators.note: the reversed times and nothing go between the letters of the city, so in signals enclosure

parts.note: NY stands for New York

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the letters run backwards
with joins the zero onto the times

parts.note: ages are long periods of time
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A bunch of flowers brings back old days of emptiness in New York.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' reverses the times and the zero, making OSEGA, which sits inside the city's initials.
explanation.definitionFit: A nosegay is a small bunch of flowers, a synonym of posy.

clue.text: Allegedly is in charge of the brakes

indicators.note: allegedly means by report, so the word is as it is said rather than spelt

parts.note: a monarch reigns, that is, is in charge

explanation.surface: Someone reportedly controls the braking system.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Allegedly' signals a sound-alike: REIGNS is said like REINS.
explanation.definitionFit: Reins restrain a horse, and figuratively are checks or curbs, matching brakes as restraints.

clue.text: Girl students took up with lounger

indicators.note: in a down entry taking up means reading from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a deb is a debutante, a society girl
NUS is the National Union of Students in the UK

explanation.surface: A young woman and classmates adopted a deckchair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'took up' reverses DEB NUS in this down entry; the NUS is the UK's National Union of Students.
explanation.definitionFit: A sunbed is a reclining chair for lying out in the sun, a kind of lounger.

clue.text: London gardens beset with rain; not how to get things for the barbecue

indicators.note: the gardens are surrounded by what is left of the rain, so beset signals enclosure
not tells us to take the given word out

parts.note: showers are spells of rain
taken as written
Kew Gardens are the Royal Botanic Gardens in south-west London

explanation.surface: A grumble about a wet day at Kew: no way to do a cookout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not how' removes those letters from the rain word, and 'beset with' wraps the remainder round the gardens; Kew is the Royal Botanic Gardens in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Skewers are metal or wooden spikes on which meat and vegetables are threaded for grilling.

clue.text: Leave in the company of drunken dowager

indicators.note: in the company of means among, so the answer is found among the letters that follow

explanation.surface: Departing with a tipsy widow of rank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leave' looks like 'depart' but is the verb meaning to bequeath.
explanation.definitionFit: To endow is to give money or property, as when one leaves a bequest to an institution.

clue.text: The brilliance of Martin and Michael?

definitions.meaning: the surname of actors Martin (Apocalypse Now) and Michael (The Queen), the question mark flagging the name

explanation.surface: Praise for the talent of two famous performers.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a soft shine or lustre, and is also the surname shared by American actor Martin and Welsh actor Michael.

clue.text: Broadcaster and keeper of the 19

definitions.meaning: a reporter who reads or presents the news on air
the man who runs a kiosk selling papers, the cross-referenced entry 19

explanation.surface: A TV presenter who also runs a kiosk.
explanation.walkthrough: 19 is NEWSSTAND, so its keeper is a vendor of papers.
explanation.definitionFit: The word can mean a journalist or presenter of news, and also a seller of newspapers.

clue.text: Await data he must select evenly from left to right

indicators.note: selecting evenly takes the second, fourth, sixth letters and so on

explanation.surface: An instruction for scanning figures across a page.
explanation.walkthrough: 'select evenly' picks the even letters of AWAIT DATA HE.
explanation.definitionFit: Width is the measurement of something from side to side, its breadth across.

clue.text: One admits to caring to get pardon certified

indicators.note: certified here means certified insane, so the letters go crazy and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A confession of compassion used to win an official pardon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'certified' means certified mad, the anagram signal, applied to PARDON and GET.
explanation.definitionFit: A sponsor at a christening formally accepts responsibility for a child's spiritual care and upbringing.

clue.text: Writer's level of proficiency is almost 10!

definitions.note: Writer's stands for writer is, the 's acting as a link

parts.note: a dan is a grade of skill in martial arts such as judo or karate

indicators.note: almost means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: ten in words

explanation.surface: An author's skill rating is nearly a perfect ten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims TEN to TE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian poet who wrote the Divine Comedy is among the most famous authors in literature.
